neighbours.label: the clause right after 'to whom' or 'with whom' (to whom they could speak, to whom you don't want ...)
fire: She has few relatives to whom she could turn for help.
If you have children to whom you don't want cash paid out, use a trust.
He named a few friends to whom he would send his book.
They listed the people to whom they had lent money.
Those were the officials to whom we could report the theft.
It lists the clients to whom we must send a notice.
I know only two people with whom I could talk about it.
These are the heirs to whom she will leave the farm.
quiet: She has few places where she could turn for help.
If you have a house where you don't want guests, tell them.
He named a few towns where he would sell his book.
They listed the shops where they had seen the coat.
Those were the rooms where we could store the boxes.
It lists the days when we must close the shop.
I know only two cafes where I could sit and read.
These are the fields where she will plant the corn.

notes: The direct logits promote ' impart', ' send', ' share', but 'want to tell him' and 'she tells you' stayed under 0.1 in the probes, so the communication reading did not hold.
